summary: Credit Suisse High Yield Credit Fund filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a transferable rights offering. The Fund, a closed-end investment company, will issue one Right per share held (record date April 21, 2026) to acquire one new common share for every three Rights. The subscription price equals 92.5% of the average NYSE American closing price over the five days ending on expiration (May 14, 2026), subject to a floor of 86% of NAV. As of April 17, shares traded at a 9.31% discount to NAV ($2.04 NAV vs $1.85 price). Oversubscription privileges are available. Rights will trade under symbol DHY RT. Watch for the final subscription price, potential dilution, and trading dynamics around expiration.
